newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine commercial banks assets up 33.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine commercial banks assets up 33.7 pct.

text.p: Total assets of Philippine commercial banks as of end-March this year rose 33.7 percent to 2.06 trillion pesos from 1.54 trillion pesos a year-ago, the central bank said on Monday.
The bank said the growth was largely derived from increases in deposits and capital accounts.
The banks' loan portfolio climbed 37.3 percent to 1.27 trillion pesos from 923.2 billion in end-March 1996. Investment accounts rose 22.7 percent to 309.7 billion pesos from 252.5 billion.
Other asset accounts grew by 50.4 percent to 241.3 billion pesos from 160.4 billion in March 1996.
The aggregate liabilities of commercial banks rose 34.4 percent as of end-March to 1.81 trillion pesos from 1.35 trillion a year-ago.
The banks' past due loans was 3.3 percent higher at 239.7 billion pesos end-March from end-December's 232.1 billion.
There were 51 commercial banks in operation nationwide as of end-March compared with 49 banks last December.
